# KorpaBee Platform

> KorpaBee is Nigeria's all-in-one social network, opportunity board, group savings (Ajo), housing match, and Place of Primary Assignment (PPA) directory built for NYSC corps members.

## Overview
KorpaBee supports over 1 million Nigerian youth during their National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) service year — from orientation camp to Passing Out Parade (POP) and beyond.

## Full Documentation & Specifications for AI
- Full AI Specification: https://korpabee.com/llms-full.txt

## Core Features & Modules
- **PPA Directory & Reviews**: Anonymous reviews, salary data, work culture, and relocation insights on Place of Primary Assignment employers across Nigeria.
- **Housing & Roommate Match**: Proximity-based rental search (near platoon/PPA) + secure roommate compatibility surveys.
- **NYSC Community Chat**: Auto-provisioned state, batch, and platoon group chats for verified corps members.
- **Jobs & CV Builder**: In-app CV builder tailored for fresh graduates + verified internship, remote, and entry-level job listings.
- **Digital Wallet & Ajo Savings**: Secure digital wallet for clearance tracking, cooperative group savings (Ajo), and microcredits.
- **BuzzHives & Social Feed**: Topic-focused community hives, media posts, comments, likes, and direct messaging.
- **Gig Marketplace**: Micro-gigs, freelance tasks, and task execution with KorpaCoin escrow protection.

## Target Audience
- NYSC Corps Members across all 36 Nigerian states and FCT Abuja.
- Prospective Corps Members (PCMs).
- Employers, PPA organizations, landlords, and recruiters in Nigeria.
